people.name: Abdi
people.line: A Levite, ancestor of Ethan the musician

people.name: Jeduthun
people.line: Levitical musician and singer during David's reign

people.name: Kishi
people.line: A Levite and father of Jeduthun (or 'Ethan')

people.name: Malluch
people.line: Son of Hashabiah, a Merarite Levite.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
translations.bsb: On the left were their kinsmen, the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
translations.kjv: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
translations.asv: And on the left hand their brethren the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
